mapper.select: SELECT p.*, t.code AS project_type_code, t.name AS project_type_name FROM promotion_project p LEFT JOIN promotion_project_type t ON t.id = p.project_type_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM promotion_project WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.*, t.code AS project_type_code, t.name AS project_type_name FROM promotion_project p LEFT JOIN promotion_project_type t ON t.id = p.project_type_id ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT * FROM promotion_project WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_project WHERE project_type_id = #{projectTypeId}
SELECT id FROM promotion_project WHERE project_type_id = #{projectTypeId} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_project (project_type_id, name, cover_image_url, project_document_url, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{projectTypeId}, #{name}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{projectDocumentUrl}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_project SET project_type_id = #{projectTypeId}, name = #{name}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, project_document_url = #{projectDocumentUrl}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
